All artwork by XXXX52 from his deleted tumblr blogs xxxx52 (March 2013 - Dec 2016) & sasoriharem (Dec 2016 - Dec 2018)

The extras include various old artworks I stumbled across while making this archive. This includes old commissions, /d requests and artwork that was shared on other platforms like hentai foundry and twitter but did not get posted to Tumblr. Also included are deleted patreon posts that were taken down because of guidelines.

Nothing after 2019 is included. Most of his art from 2019 onwards can be found on patreon.
